games.name: [EARLY PAID ACCESS] Havoc
games.desc:
Use code SEASONTWO

Havoc immerses players in the aftermath of The Silence, a world where factions fight for survival and territory.

This is a hardcore extraction shooter built around real risk and consequence. It is loud, punishing, and unforgiving. Headphones are strongly recommended to hear threats early, as success depends entirely on your skill.

Havoc is currently available as paid access. Purchasing grants immediate access to the current build and all future updates.

>> The game runs on seasonal wipes. Gear, stash, and progress reset each season, but your profile and cosmetics are permanent.

Keybinds can be viewed in the Settings menu but cannot be changed at the moment.

>> The game is available on Console and PC. Controllers are not supported; mouse and keyboard are required.

games.name: Absolvement [ALPHA]
games.desc:
An end of a lifetime, or the beginning of an era? Nobody knows what lies at the end. In fact, most believe there is no end. You struggle to differentiate between your true memories and false ones planted from your fleeting consciousness as you shatter your body but not your soul.

<> Absolvement is currently in the ALPHA development stage. <>
Fundamentals of the game may change as we release updates!

- Play solo or in parties up to 5 players
- Branded by sins, affixes, and burdens - freely choose your rate of progression and your own personal difficulty
- Classless character design and progression
- Over 130 abilities to use and build synergies with
- Earn Soul Fragments when your character wipes to unlock 200+ buffs in the Soul Tree for your next character

Absolvement is a roguelite dungeon crawler developed by Amorian Skies.
Nominated in the 2025 Creator Awards for Best Narrative.
All in-game music is our own composed OST! 
Playable on PC and Console with controller support.

games.name: Parkour Pandemic [UPDATE 2!]
games.desc:
(IMPORTANT: Development for Parkour Pandemic has paused due to personal reasons. Thank you all for your outstanding support!)

[THIS GAME IS IN BETA EXPECT BUGS]

The Fracture broke the world's clock. Time runs in a loop now, replaying the disasters that ended a hundred worlds. You're a survivor, You don't know how you got here...

This is a fast-paced running game where you survive disasters that tear the map apart around you. Rounds get harder as the clock runs down. Activate beacons to shorten the rounds time

B - Emote
Q – Dash
C – Slide
Double Space – Double Jump

(Special mechanic controls:)

R – Air Blast (Power Gear)
Space near a wall – Wall Boost (Speed Gear)
Press the dash key again after a dash Q – Power Dash (Power Gear)
